lines.trans: Hands off, is everything in order?
Watch, my mom is about to notice us as if by chance.
Olivier, meet my mom Eleonora.
Very pleased to meet you.
And I am very pleased too, join us.
By the way, thank you for moving me to the luxury suite.
The suite is simply magnificent.
Do you treat all guests like this?
All our guests receive only the very best.
Good afternoon, I am the head chef of this restaurant.
Here is your fillet of wild pigeon in sauce.
Thank you very much, Viktor.

examples.text: Вот ваше филе дикого голубя в соусе.
examples.trans: Here is your fillet of wild pigeon in sauce.

examples.text: Главное, не пережарь это нежное филе.
examples.trans: The main thing is do not overcook this tender fillet.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('wild, terrible').

examples.text: Вот ваше филе дикого голубя в соусе.
examples.trans: Here is your fillet of wild pigeon in sauce.

examples.text: Были дикие боли.
examples.trans: There was terrible pain.

examples.text: В лесу живут дикие звери.
examples.trans: Wild animals live in the forest.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'pigeon / squab' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Филе голубя и блюдо из рыбы.
examples.trans: Fillet of pigeon and the fish dish.

examples.text: Вот ваше филе дикого голубя в соусе.
examples.trans: Here is your fillet of wild pigeon in sauce.

examples.text: По-моему, голубь немного сухой, но я не эксперт.
examples.trans: In my opinion, the pigeon is a bit dry, though I am no expert.

meanings.note: Borrowed from French 'sauce' (ultimately from Latin 'salsa', salted seasoning).

examples.text: Вот ваше филе дикого голубя в соусе.
examples.trans: Here is your fillet of wild pigeon in sauce.

examples.text: Паста под соусом была очень вкусной.
examples.trans: The pasta with sauce was very tasty.

examples.text: Повар приготовил острый томатный соус.
examples.trans: The chef prepared a spicy tomato sauce.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('very much, big').

examples.text: Это небольшой бизнес, а ты как?
examples.trans: It is a small business trip, and how about you?

examples.text: Когда он заснул на занятии, я проучился на месяц больше, чем ты.
examples.trans: When he fell asleep in class, I studied a month longer than you.

examples.text: Большое спасибо, Виктор.
examples.trans: Thank you very much, Viktor.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'appetite' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Приятного аппетита!
examples.trans: Bon appétit!

examples.text: Приятного аппетита.
examples.trans: Enjoy your meal.

examples.text: У него хороший аппетит.
examples.trans: He has a good appetite.
